boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named SJSU places for studying, services, recreation, events, and campus history, each verified against a direct university source.

cards.entity_name: Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Library
cards.title: Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Library
cards.subtitle: Main Campus library
cards.notes: Use the official building-access page to plan a study session; it lists the library as open until midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed campus library with late listed building access on several days.
cards.evidence_claim: SJSU lists the Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Library as a library building with Monday–Thursday and Sunday access until midnight.
cards.source_title: Building Access | Facilities Development and Operations
cards.access_notes: Listed building access: Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–midnight; Fri 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sat 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sun 1 p.m.–midnight. Check the library site for exceptions.

cards.title: Diaz Compean Student Union
cards.subtitle: Student life, meetings, and campus services
cards.notes: Start at the building directory when coordinating a meetup or service stop; the union lists campus departments, organizations, and meeting spaces inside.
cards.short_summary: A named student-life building that combines services, organizations, and reservable spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: SJSU identifies the Diaz Compean Student Union as a facility containing student services, organizations, meeting spaces, and study spaces.
cards.source_title: Documents and Disclosures | Student Union, Inc. at SJSU
cards.access_notes: Listed building access: Mon–Thu 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; Fri 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sat 8 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sun noon–11 p.m. Individual services may differ.

cards.title: SJSU Bowling Center
cards.subtitle: Inside the Diaz Compean Student Union
cards.notes: Check the Bowling Center’s current hours before organizing a group game; the Student Union posts evening hours and directs visitors to its Instagram for updates.
cards.short_summary: A named campus recreation venue with official late-evening hours posted.
cards.evidence_claim: SJSU’s Student Union lists Bowling Center hours until 11 p.m. on every day shown on its current hours page.
cards.source_title: Hours | Student Union, Inc. at SJSU
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; Fri 10 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sat–Sun noon–11 p.m. Verify updates before visiting.

cards.title: Spartan Recreation and Aquatic Center
cards.subtitle: Fitness, courts, climbing, pools, and esports
cards.notes: Use the SRAC listing to choose an activity together, from indoor courts and the running track to climbing, pools, or esports; membership may be required.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose recreation facility with indoor activity and aquatic spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: SJSU describes the SRAC as offering gym equipment, indoor ball courts, a running track, climbing wall, pools, and esports for its community.
cards.source_title: Student Recreation and Aquatic Center | SJSU Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Listed building access: Mon–Fri 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sat 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sun 9 a.m.–10 p.m. Membership and facility rules apply.

cards.title: Student Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Across from the Event Center
cards.notes: Locate the first-floor lobby when you need a wellness-service starting point; the center identifies public common areas and requires visitors to check in.
cards.short_summary: A named student-support building with specified public common areas.
cards.evidence_claim: SJSU says the Student Wellness Center is across from the Event Center and identifies its lobby and certain first-floor corridors as limited public-access spaces.
cards.access_notes: Listed fall/spring office hours: Mon–Thu 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; Fri 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Non-student visitors must check in; other areas require approval.

cards.title: Associated Students House
cards.subtitle: Conference-room space for SJSU students and staff
cards.notes: Reserve the Fireside Conference Room or Board Room for a group meeting; Associated Students says these rooms are free for SJSU students and staff during business hours.
cards.short_summary: A campus meeting-space option with two named conference rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Associated Students states that the A.S. House has free conference-room space for SJSU students and staff during regular business hours.
cards.access_notes: Reservation confirmation is required. The page lists fall business hours as Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; confirm current availability with A.S.

cards.title: Provident Credit Union Event Center
cards.subtitle: Map-listed campus event venue
cards.notes: Check the campus events calendar for a public program before heading over; SJSU’s Student Union identifies this as one of its core facilities.
cards.short_summary: A named university event facility within the Student Union organization.
cards.evidence_claim: SJSU states that Student Union, Inc. includes the Provident Credit Union Event Center among its facilities.
cards.source_title: Documents and Disclosures | Student Union, Inc. at SJSU
cards.access_notes: Access depends on a scheduled event and its ticketing or entry policy; verify the event listing before visiting.

cards.title: Victory Salute (Olympic Black Power)
cards.subtitle: Tower Lawn public artwork
cards.notes: Pause at Tower Lawn to look closely at this mosaic monument, then use SJSU’s public-art page for context on Smith, Carlos, artist Rigo 23, and the 1968 protest.
cards.short_summary: A campus-commissioned monument linking SJSU alumni and athlete activism.
cards.evidence_claim: SJSU identifies Victory Salute as a 2005 monument by Rigo 23, commissioned by the university and placed on Tower Lawn.
cards.source_title: Victory Salute | Public Art as Resistance in San Jose
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public artwork on Tower Lawn; observe from public campus walkways and follow campus access rules.

cards.entity_name: César E. Chávez Monument: Arch of Dignity, Equality and Justice
cards.title: César E. Chávez Monument
cards.subtitle: Arch of Dignity, Equality and Justice
cards.notes: Add this named campus landmark to a walking route using the official map, which identifies the monument by its full title among SJSU points of interest.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor campus monument documented on the official map.
cards.evidence_claim: SJSU’s official campus map lists the César E. Chávez Monument: Arch of Dignity, Equality and Justice as a campus point of interest.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor map-listed landmark. Use the current interactive campus map for routing and observe campus access rules.

cards.title: Spartan Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: Map-listed campus landmark
cards.notes: Include this named chapel when walking between campus landmarks; the official SJSU map identifies Spartan Memorial Chapel among the main-campus points of interest.
cards.short_summary: A named chapel documented on the official main-campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: SJSU’s official campus map lists Spartan Memorial Chapel as a point of interest on the main campus.
cards.access_notes: Confirm whether the chapel interior is open before entering; outdoor viewing and campus access remain subject to university rules.
